hardware.notes: 6 sweep points in parallel, each pinned to its own core with taskset (cores 8..13), single-threaded CPU prover (EngineCpu). Points with log_len >= 20 were serialized by a memory semaphore. Other research lanes were running on the same VM; timings are indicative, not exclusive.

security_setting.note: Toy soundness target used to make the sweep tractable. NOT a production setting. plan_t128.txt holds planner-only byte counts at target 128.

weights: synthetic only (numpy default_rng), no checkpoint downloaded
